title: Daily dashboard
description: Health (Garmin) and mobility (ritregistratie) lights. Thresholds live in dashboard.health_config and dashboard.mobility_config; see the daily-dashboard README.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       reasons AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(overall_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.health_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       coalesce(sleep_hours || ' h' || coalesce(' (score ' || sleep_score || ')', ''), 'No sleep data') AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(sleep_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.health_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       coalesce(body_battery_at_wake || ' at wake', 'No body battery data') AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(body_battery_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.health_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       coalesce(resting_hr || ' bpm' || coalesce(' (baseline ' || resting_hr_baseline || ')', ', no baseline yet'), 'No resting HR') AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(resting_hr_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.health_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       CASE WHEN stress_status = 'pending' THEN 'Judged after today' ELSE coalesce(stress_high_pct || '% high, avg ' || stress_avg, 'No stress data') END AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(stress_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.health_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       CASE training_status WHEN 'green' THEN 'Done: ' || coalesce(training_done, '') WHEN 'amber' THEN 'Missed: ' || training_missed WHEN 'pending' THEN 'Planned: ' || training_missed WHEN 'grey' THEN 'No data' ELSE coalesce('Optional: ' || training_planned, 'Nothing planned') END AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(training_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.health_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       coalesce(weight_avg_kg || ' kg 7d avg, ' || to_char(weight_trend_kg_per_week, 'SG0.00') || ' kg/wk vs target ' || to_char(weight_target_kg_per_week, 'SG0.00') || ' (' || weight_phase || ')', 'Not enough weigh-ins') AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(weight_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.health_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       dashboard.status_level(overall_status)    AS "Overall",
       dashboard.status_level(sleep_status)      AS "Sleep",
       dashboard.status_level(body_battery_status) AS "Body battery",
       dashboard.status_level(resting_hr_status) AS "Resting HR",
       dashboard.status_level(stress_status)     AS "Stress",
       dashboard.status_level(training_status)   AS "Training"
FROM dashboard.health_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz::date AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz::date
ORDER BY day

SELECT day AS "Day",
       overall_status AS "Overall",
       reasons AS "Reasons",
       sleep_hours AS "Sleep (h)",
       body_battery_at_wake AS "Body battery at wake",
       resting_hr AS "Resting HR",
       resting_hr_baseline AS "RHR baseline",
       stress_high_pct AS "High stress %",
       training_done AS "Training done",
       steps AS "Steps",
       weight_avg_kg AS "Weight 7d (kg)"
FROM dashboard.health_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz::date AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz::date
ORDER BY day DESC

panels.title: Mobility today

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       reasons AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(overall_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.mobility_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

panels.description: Worst of the cost and car-km lights. The to-dos don't count. Settings: dashboard.mobility_config and dashboard.vehicles (daily-dashboard README).

panels.title: Cost (7 days)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       'EUR ' || round(total_cost_7d) || ' of ' || trim_scale(cost_budget_7d) || ' (' || round(cost_7d_pct) || '%)' AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(cost_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.mobility_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

panels.description: Variable + fixed cost of the last 7 days vs 7 x daily budget. Green <= 100 %, amber <= 120 %.

panels.title: Car km (7 days)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       car_km_7d || ' of ' || trim_scale(weekly_car_km_target) || ' km' AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(car_km_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.mobility_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

panels.description: Km of vehicles that count as a car, last 7 days, vs the weekly target. Amber up to 125 %.

panels.title: To do: keep-alive

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       coalesce(keepalive_vehicle || ', ' || keepalive_days_since || ' days since last trip', 'No trip logged yet') AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(keepalive_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.mobility_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

panels.description: Days since the keep-alive vehicle (V220) was driven. Amber from 10, red from 14. Doesn't affect the overall status.

panels.title: To do: log trip

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       CASE WHEN NOT is_office_day THEN 'Not an office day' WHEN registration_status = 'green' THEN 'Business trip logged' ELSE 'No business trip logged' END AS metric,
       dashboard.status_level(registration_status) AS value
FROM dashboard.mobility_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()

panels.description: On office days (Tue, Thu) a business trip should be logged in ritregistratie. Doesn't affect the overall status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       vehicle AS metric,
       km AS value
FROM dashboard.mobility_vehicle_daily
WHERE day = dashboard.local_today()
  AND (active OR km > 0)
ORDER BY vehicle

panels.title: Petrol (7 days)
panels.description: Rolling 7-day total; the sparkline shows it over the dashboard's time range. Shown, not judged.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       petrol_l_7d AS value
FROM dashboard.mobility_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz::date AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz::date
ORDER BY day

SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       dashboard.status_level(overall_status)      AS "Overall",
       dashboard.status_level(cost_status)         AS "Cost",
       dashboard.status_level(car_km_status)       AS "Car km",
       dashboard.status_level(keepalive_status)    AS "To do: keep-alive",
       dashboard.status_level(registration_status) AS "To do: log trip"
FROM dashboard.mobility_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz::date AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz::date
ORDER BY day

panels.title: Cost per day
panels.description: Variable (km x consumption x price) and fixed (yearly fixed costs of active vehicles / 365).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam') AS time,
       variable_cost AS "Variable",
       fixed_cost AS "Fixed"
FROM dashboard.mobility_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz::date AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz::date
ORDER BY day

SELECT day AS "Day",
       overall_status AS "Overall",
       reasons AS "Reasons",
       total_km AS "Km",
       car_km AS "Car km",
       business_km AS "Business km",
       private_km AS "Private km",
       total_cost AS "Cost",
       business_cost AS "Business cost",
       private_cost AS "Private cost",
       reimbursement AS "Reimbursement"
FROM dashboard.mobility_daily
WHERE day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz::date AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz::date
ORDER BY day DESC
